sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，热身 v2-3：宽距侧蹲左右移重心 每侧 5 次）

purpose.zh: 打开大腿内侧和髋，左右移重心，为腿部动作热身
purpose.en: Opens the inner thighs and hips as you shift side to side, warming up for leg work.

text.zh: 两脚宽站脚尖外转，蹲到大腿接近水平
text.en: Wide stance, toes out, thigh about level

text.zh: 站距约两倍肩宽，脚尖朝外大约 20 度。
text.en: Feet about twice shoulder width, toes turned out about 20 degrees.

text.zh: 伸直那条腿膝盖伸直，脚尖朝上，脚跟着地。
text.en: The straight leg stays straight, toes up, heel on the floor.

text.zh: 胸口抬起，双手前伸帮助平衡，蹲那侧脚跟踩实。
text.en: Chest up, arms forward for balance, heel of the bending leg flat.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the heel of the bending leg.

cautions.zh: 膝盖或大腿内侧疼就蹲浅一点
cautions.en: If your knee or inner thigh hurts, go shallower.

training.source: flare2 r2 animation tempo (4 s per side: 1.3 s down, 0.7 s bottom, 1.3 s up, 0.7 s stand); 表：每侧 5 次，左右各一次计 1 次

flare2.item: 热身 v2-3：宽距侧蹲左右移重心 每侧 5 次
flare2.camera: 正前略高（看得到站距、脚尖方向和蹲深）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：每侧 5 次，左右交替
flare2.note: Animation r2: ankles 72 cm apart (1.9x shoulder width), toes out 20 deg, bending thigh ~20 deg below horizontal at the bottom, straight knee >=174 deg with toes up 40 deg, feet stay planted (pins 0 mm). Right side first in the loop.

reminders.zh: 蹲那侧脚跟踩实，伸直腿脚尖朝上
reminders.en: Bending heel flat, straight leg toes up

reminders.zh: 胸口抬起，膝盖跟脚尖同一个方向
reminders.en: Chest up, knee in line with the toes
